houseLimitOne: This plan includes a single home.

accountLead: Name, language and theme stay on your account.
emailReadonly: The email address cannot be changed here.
homeLead: Choose a section. Family and Home can already be used.
vaultBody: Accounts, policies and important documents will live here. Contents stay encrypted on the device. They cannot be entered yet.
personalBody: Your own details will live here: phone, vehicles, accounts and tax documents. They cannot be entered yet.
printBody: From here you will prepare sheets to print and the code to hang at home. They cannot be generated yet.
extraBody: Kitchen, pantry, shopping and family finances will arrive in this section.
guideFamilyBody: Each account can create one or more families. The first home is created with the family. If you belong to several families, open them from Family or from the switcher at the top.
guideHouseBody: The switcher at the top changes home and stays on the same section. The last open home is remembered on your account.
guideThemeBody: In Account choose light, dark or automatic. Automatic follows the device. Before sign-in the choice stays only on this device.
guideRestBody: Vault, Personal, Print and code, and Extra are already in the menu. Their contents will arrive with the later modules, on the same paths.
unexpected: Something went wrong. Reload the page.
